title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 25 ]

items.text: Call me between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. by day and between 8 and 11 p.m. by night.
alternatives: Call me between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. by day and between 8 p.m. and 11 p.m. by night.
Call me between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. by day and between 8:00 and 11:00 p.m. by night.

items.text: I worked at a factory by day and studied at a library by night.
alternatives: I worked in a factory by day and studied in a library by night.
I worked at a factory by day and studied at the library by night.
By day I worked at a factory and by night I studied at a library.

alternatives: May I have tomorrow off?
